body.name: Fixed-query independent-calendar subclass
body.construction:
For each fixed admissible query \(z_0\), define
\[
 \mathcal M^{\mathrm{iid}}_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0)
 =\left\{\mathbb P_{z_0}\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0):
 (X_{s1},\ldots,X_{sT})\text{ are independent under }\mathbb P_{z_0}
 \text{ for every }s\right\}.
\]
Only the design dates are required to be independent.  Responses may remain arbitrarily dependent across dates within a unit history.
